notes.title: Patch to "Overlay words" wordsearch update.
notes.notes:
Found a bug in one of the loading mechanisms for continuing saved games.
The bug was introduced in the "Overlay words" update on the 28th February where I changed the format of save game files, but hadn't correctly coded how one of the types of word list was reloaded when it was from an old style save file.

notes.title: Mouse button update.
notes.notes: Changed the way the mouse buttons control the game and added an option to allow selection of what the buttons do to the game board (it is on settings tab 2). Therefore in general (depending on what the buttons did before) you can select primary to rotate and secondary to select etc instead of the default of primary selects, middle moves and right rotates. Note that in making this change that I had to decide whether an action resulting from a button press should change based on the setting, or stay the same because it wasn't related to the select/move/rotate principle - e.g. the buttons fall into this latter category, however some things fell a little between the two, in particular in the workshop screens, and therefore changing the setting may not make everything change to every ones tastes.

notes.title: Patch notes

- Changes to the standard colour scheme. It now has a background image plus some transparency has been removed.
- Panels added around the game setup screen and the settings option from the main menu, to offset previous use of transparency to derive background colour on these screens.
- Changed the way cell count field shown so it doesn't just blend into dark backgrounds (e.g. on the Night colour scheme).
- Added a new "Transparent" colour scheme option which is similar to the old standard colour scheme.
- Fix to the "Next" button on the "Codeword" screen, it would disappear on smaller screen sizes (e.g. when running in a window).
- Fix the size of the player name in the "Battle Board" setup screen. It was no longer linked to the interface scale setting.
- Fix to a bug with table image loading where data was checked using the wrong indexing values.
- Fix a saving issue in the voxel designer.
- WIP. Specific spherical skyboxes for some specific boards/shapes (e.g. added an "asteroid field" for the imperial star "Destroyer" shape and the "Tardi3d" board). Note that it's currently linked to the "extra textures" setting being ticked, and that no such feature has currently hasn't been added to the "Word Hunt" game, nor to other non-board/shape related games.
- Fix to mapping issue with falcon "Freighter" board, 4 adjacent cell pairs only linked in one direction.

notes.title: Board design patch
notes.notes: Made some changes to the way the board designer saves the data. Instead of relying on recreating the same arrangement of cell ids when using the board, will now save shape data. Also changed the way cell edges are formed when using boards formed from board backgrounds, because the way the data is stored is no longer the same as the original mechanism (eg the Marble board). Therefore the effect should now look the same in both cases.

notes.title: Changes for large boards
notes.notes:
This incorporates some changes made to the Wordsearch attack game.
[list]
[*] Added option to draw the backs of cells on the board. It is sometimes possible for the camera to be 'inside' the board, effectively looking out. Therefore you might see nothing, however with this option on you'll see the reverse of the cells. This should affect the Wordsearch, Word Hunt and BattleBoard game modes. Note that this will probably reduce graphical performance.
[*] In wordsearch game, improved the performance of trying to place large numbers of words onto large boards. Previously it would top out at about 1000 words in 30seconds (depending on system performance), now it should manage 5 times as many words in that time. Note that large boards realistically don't play very well both technically and enjoyably - it would probably take days to find 1000s of words on a board.
[/list]

notes.title: Wordsearch Attack Update
notes.notes:
Word Attack is a suite of games, as such it is harder to describe and promote than would otherwise be the case. Therefore I decided to take a more focussed concept and spin it off in a stand alone format - hence Wordsearch Attack.
This update includes a number of changes, some of which are to keep it in line with Wordsearch Attack.

To simplify the starting of wordsearch games, I've simplified the board list by introducing Cuboid, Cylinder, Grid and Hex shape classes, rather than specifically sized shapes such as the 7x7x7 cube, 40x19 cylinder etc. When you select a shape class you now need to specify the dimensions to use - Note that this will allow the creation of very large boards, your hardware may not be up to running such large shapes!! Additionally, instead of selecting a dictionary, personality, familiarity etc, you now select a word list. Word lists can be dictionaries or actual lists of words, but in Word Attack can also be personalities (Wordsearch Attack does not have personalities). Also added optional cell edging to boards.

The Word Hunt game gets similar updates to the board creation - Note that the larger boards will need more hardware to run them.

BattleBoards do not get the new board selection. This is because they have boards from the board designer. Instead the board designer gets these changes, so you can select a shape and it's sizes and create a BattleBoard for those dimensions. Once created you can then use it in the BattleBoard game.

Other changes in this update.
- Changes to running in a window:
  - Rotation changes so that effect of dragging board is related to board offset and not centre of screen/window.
  - Changing panel sizes down when window size changed.
  - Change to scrolling windows while resizing them.
- Cell edging changes.
- Highlight changes.
- Colour fixes.
- Revisions to word list loading and filtering.
- Music changes.

notes.title: Tactical changes.
notes.notes:
- In the Slide game, added a button that allows you to see the next tile that will slide onto the board, which also acts as a mechanism to change that tile to another one. This should improve the tactical gameplay as it will no longer appear that the next tile is entirely random.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43002912/e0839f3ae1bd8c9ded1a67fbc948d8b0e83ced3b.png[/img]

- Added option in the Word Hunt game that allows the showing of empty tiles around found words. This makes the game more tactical by removing some of the need to randomly guess as to where the letters might be, and gives an advantage for finding whole words.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43002912/8966109482654f885a4fc96f32ec8213019dbc23.png[/img]

- Improvement to the placing of words in the Word Hunt game, to stop words overlapping one another, even when cramming words in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43002912/3fa5c7464d97650828706a3c0cd46c6bd999cfcf.png[/img]

notes.notes:
Changes to the texturing of boards.
There are now 2 extra options in the settings screen, board textures and extra textures. Boards can now have their own texturing, and if they have then board textures indicates if they should be used. Extra textures dictates if general texturing should be added, beyond the use of specific board textures.

notes.title: Rotation changes
notes.notes:
The default way boards rotate has been changed, and there is an additional control to toggle between the new mechanism and the old mechanism.

To toggle between the two mechanisms there is an additional ring on the rotation gizmo which you can click on (or alternatively you can use the space bar).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43002912/cb9b1b3ed9db24b618c31f5c8f08501c769d588e.jpg[/img]

With the new mechanism, when you drag with the mouse (while holding the secondary mouse button) the board will rotate in the direction you move in. With the previous mechanism, if you are looking at the top of the board then left/right movement will rotate the board around the boards axis rather than in the direction you are facing. Note also that the same control also flips whether the arrow keys move the object or the camera.

notes.title: Another technical update
notes.notes:
Following on from the previous technical update, this further expands on how boards can be formed.
Boards are formed from a web of interconnecting cells, this updates changes the way those connections can be made. As long as cells have a balanced number of connections, virtually any shape is theoretically possible. It also fixes an issue in the previous update which resulted in incorrect paths being formed at the corners of cube shaped boards.

notes.title: Technical update
notes.notes:
This is primarily an update to the wordsearch sub-game. It introduces new types of boards and new ways to define the boards. At this stage the result is that you can now play the wordsearch game on boards of rectangles and shaped boards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43002912/d8270a556a3ca69abd7f89217aa9d80e05f59c15.jpg[/img]

Boards no longer need to be flat, instead they can wrap around themselves, such as with this cylinder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43002912/2578f6fcde074b05a1b82cca59f5d8a7ad85051c.jpg[/img]

Additional changes across the game include:
- changes to the camera (so you can see 360° around 3D objects)
- changes to the lighting (so you can see the objects from "behind")
